title: A Political Economy Model of Infrastructure Allocation: An Empirical Assessment
title_zh: 基础设施配置的政治经济学模型：一项实证评估
authors: Lars Hendrik Röller, Olivier Cadot, Andreas Stephan, Lars Hendrik Röller; Olivier Cadot; Andreas Stephan
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper proposes a simultaneous-equation approach to the estimation of the contribution of transport infrastructure accumulation to regional growth. We model explicitly the political-economy process driving infrastructure investments; in doing so, we eliminate a potential source of bias in production-function estimates and generate testable hypotheses on the forces that shape infrastructure policy. Our empirical findings on a panel of France's regions over 1985-91 suggest that influence activities were, indeed, significant determinants of the cross-regional allocation of transportation infrastructure investments. Moreover, we find little evidence of concern for the maximization of economic returns to infrastructure spending, even after controlling for pork-barrel and when imposing an exogenous preference for convergence in regional productivity levels.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种联立方程方法，用于估算交通基础设施积累对区域增长的贡献。我们明确构建了驱动基础设施投资的政治经济学过程模型；通过这一方法，我们消除了生产函数估计中潜在的偏误来源，并生成了关于塑造基础设施政策力量的可检验假设。基于法国各地区1985-1991年面板数据的实证结果表明，游说活动确实是交通基础设施投资跨区域分配的重要决定因素。此外，即使在控制政治分肥因素并施加外生的区域生产率趋同偏好后，我们仍发现基础设施支出经济回报最大化的考量证据不足。

title: Switching Between Existing and New Trade Agreements: Evidence From Japan's Imports From Vietnam
title_zh: 现有贸易协定与新贸易协定之间的切换：来自日本从越南进口的证据
abstract: We empirically investigate the utilization rates of the two existing regional trade agreements (RTAs) in Japan's monthly imports from Vietnam from January 2017 to December 2021. In particular, we explore the changes in these rates before and after the commencement of the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans‐Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), focusing on the products for which CPTPP offered the lowest tariffs. We did not find significant changes in the utilization rates of either existing RTAs or the most‐favoured nation (MFN) regime before CPTPP's entry in January 2019. However, exporters familiar with the use of preferences (i.e., existing RTA users) appear to have switched to CPTPP first, followed by unfamiliar users (MFN users) who switched to it gradually. Consequently, the introduction of a new RTA was associated with a sustained expansion of trade, unlike the gradual tariff reduction in a single RTA observed in the previous study.
abstract_zh: 本文实证研究了2017年1月至2021年12月期间，日本从越南月度进口中两项现有区域贸易协定（RTAs）的利用率。我们特别关注《全面与进步跨太平洋伙伴关系协定》（CPTPP）生效前后这些利用率的变化，重点分析CPTPP提供最低关税的产品。研究发现，在2019年1月CPTPP生效前，现有RTAs或最惠国待遇（MFN）机制的利用率并未出现显著变化。然而，熟悉优惠使用的出口商（即现有RTA用户）似乎率先转向CPTPP，随后不熟悉优惠使用的用户（MFN用户）逐步跟进。因此，新RTAs的引入与贸易的持续扩张相关联，这与先前研究中单一RTA逐步降税所观察到的模式有所不同。

title: Integrating Out Natural Disaster Shocks
abstract: We study the role of international financial integration in buffering natural disaster shocks, using a large sample of advanced and emerging economies. Natural disasters are largely unpredictable and unrelated to the state of financial integration. We document that integration improves the absorption of such shocks: Output, consumption, and investment are significantly higher after a natural disaster in states with high than in states with low integration. The benefits are most clear for advanced economies. Emerging markets tend to profit from financial integration, too, but the estimates are less precise unless we condition on institutional quality or consider only debt assets. (JEL E21, E22, E23, F32, F33, F34, Q54)
abstract_zh: 本文利用发达经济体与新兴经济体的广泛样本，研究国际金融一体化在缓冲自然灾害冲击中的作用。自然灾害在很大程度上具有不可预测性，且与金融一体化程度无关。我们证实，金融一体化能够改善此类冲击的吸收效果：在自然灾害发生后，金融一体化程度较高的经济体，其产出、消费和投资水平显著高于一体化程度较低的经济体。这种效益在发达经济体中最为明显。新兴市场同样能从金融一体化中获益，但除非我们以制度质量作为条件或仅考虑债务资产，否则相关估计结果的精确度较低。（JEL分类号：E21, E22, E23, F32, F33, F34, Q54）

title: Input Price Discrimination: The Role of Retail Effort Spillovers
title_zh: 投入品价格歧视：零售努力溢出效应的作用
abstract: We investigate input price discrimination under secret contracting between a manufacturer and competing retailers, whose investment activities exhibit retail effort spillovers. We show that the economic effects of input price discrimination vary with the sign and magnitude of retail effort spillovers according to the contractual structure, namely, linear or two‐part tariffs. Retail effort spillovers and product differentiation affect the pass‐through of input price to retail quantity, which is defined under each contractual structure. Our analysis provides novel insights into the role of retail effort spillovers and into the evaluation of quantity pass‐through in the antitrust scrutiny of input price discrimination.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了制造商与竞争性零售商之间秘密合同下的投入品价格歧视问题，其中零售商的投资活动存在零售努力溢出效应。研究表明，投入品价格歧视的经济效应随零售努力溢出的正负及大小而变化，且这种变化取决于合同结构（线性关税或两部收费制）。零售努力溢出与产品差异化会影响投入品价格向零售数量的传导效应，该传导效应在不同合同结构下具有不同定义。本文分析为理解零售努力溢出的作用机制，以及反垄断审查中评估数量传导效应对投入品价格歧视的影响提供了全新视角。

title: Importing Aggregate Demand
authors: Chen Lian, Dmitry Mukhin, Christian Wolf
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How exposed are open economies to global demand shocks? In equilibrium, foreign booms can be absorbed either by domestic consumption ("quantities") or by real exchange rate appreciation ("prices"). We show that failures of Ricardian equivalence and global financial market imperfections, two frictions popular in much recent work, have opposite effects on the split: while elevated marginal propensities to consume push towards quantities, financial frictions instead increase price adjustment. As the flexible-price equilibrium generally features a mix of quantity and price responses, policy needs to be contractionary to achieve flexible-price outcomes if the spending effect dominates, and vice-versa if financial frictions are severe. In our quantitative explorations the spending effect tends to win the race, necessitating aggressive domestic policy action.
abstract_zh: 开放经济体对全球需求冲击的暴露程度如何？在均衡状态下，国外经济繁荣可通过国内消费（“数量”）或实际汇率升值（“价格”）两种渠道吸收。本文证明，李嘉图等价失效与全球金融市场不完善——近期研究中常见的两类摩擦——对上述分配机制具有相反影响：边际消费倾向上升会推动数量调整，而金融摩擦则强化价格调整。由于弹性价格均衡通常兼具数量与价格反应特征，当支出效应占主导时，政策需采取紧缩措施以实现弹性价格均衡；反之，若金融摩擦严重，则需采取扩张政策。在量化分析中，支出效应往往占据上风，这要求采取积极的国内政策干预。

title: Characterizing the File Drawer: Evidence from a Meta-Analysis of Parent-Interventions Around the World
title_zh: 描述文件抽屉：基于全球家长干预元分析的证据
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We conduct a meta-analysis of 82 randomized controlled trials across more than 20 countries to estimate the effects of low-cost, remote parental engagement interventions delivered through text messages, phone calls, and apps. We estimate a joint likelihood function that incorporates both written studies and unwritten studies identified through trial registries, funder records, research labs, evidence clearinghouses, and other sources. By also recording sample sizes for unwritten studies, the model estimates the distribution of standard errors, identifies write-up probabilities conditional on significance, and characterizes the file drawer by estimating effect distributions for written and unwritten studies. Bias-corrected effects are 0.05 SD for test scores, 0.07 SD for grades, 0.05 SD for attendance, and 0.03 SD for enrollment. In the best-identified domain, test scores, statistically insignificant results are still written up at high rates. We also find that larger studies tend to estimate smaller latent effects, which could indicate that true effects are correlated with study precision, violating a common meta-analysis assumption. In smaller-sample domains, our approach helps identify selection probabilities by anchoring the absolute write-up rates. Finally, we estimate the value of additional RCTs to inform adoption decisions. Any single study estimate is unlikely to dissuade adoption because parent interventions have high marginal value of public funds. Instead, future research is most valuable when it can explain heterogeneity across settings.
abstract_zh: 我们对来自20多个国家的82项随机对照试验进行了元分析，以评估通过短信、电话和应用程序实施的低成本、远程家长参与干预措施的效果。我们构建了一个联合似然函数，该函数整合了已发表研究以及通过试验注册库、资助方记录、研究实验室、证据数据库及其他来源识别的未发表研究。通过同时记录未发表研究的样本量，该模型估计了标准误的分布，识别了基于显著性的撰写概率，并通过估计已发表与未发表研究的效果分布来刻画文件抽屉效应。经偏差校正后的效果为：考试成绩0.05个标准差、学业成绩0.07个标准差、出勤率0.05个标准差、入学率0.03个标准差。在识别效果最佳的考试成绩领域，统计不显著的结果仍以较高比例被撰写发表。我们还发现，样本量较大的研究倾向于估计出更小的潜在效应，这可能表明真实效应与研究精度存在相关性，从而违反了元分析中的常见假设。在样本量较小的领域，我们的方法通过锚定绝对撰写率来帮助识别选择概率。最后，我们估算了额外随机对照试验的价值，以指导采纳决策。由于家长干预措施具有较高的公共资金边际价值，任何单一研究估计值都不太可能阻止其被采纳。相反，当未来研究能够解释不同情境下的异质性时，其价值最为显著。

title: Innovation, Patenting and Appropriability: Survey Evidence from a Nationally Representative Sample of U.S. Firms
title_zh: 创新、专利与专有性：基于美国企业全国代表性样本的调查证据
abstract: We document a series of stylized facts about how firms seek to protect the rents from innovation, using a large nationally representative survey of U.S. businesses over the period 2008-2015. Just 1.4 percent of firms obtain patents, but these patenting firms account for 87 percent of R&D investment. Firms consider utility patents less important than other forms of IP protection, like trade secrets, trademarks, and copyrights. Firm industry and size are strongly correlated with firms’ use of all types of intellectual property, but firm-age is not. Implications for innovation research and policy are discussed.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2008-2015年间美国企业的大规模全国代表性调查数据，系统记录了企业如何寻求保护创新租金的一系列典型事实。仅有1.4%的企业获得专利，但这些专利企业却占据了研发投资的87%。企业认为实用专利的重要性低于其他形式的知识产权保护，如商业秘密、商标和版权。企业所属行业和规模与其使用各类知识产权的行为高度相关，但企业年龄则不然。本文讨论了这些发现对创新研究与政策制定的启示。

title: Politicians’ Social Welfare Criteria An Experiment With German Legislators
title_zh: 德国立法者政治家的社会福利标准实验
authors: Sandro Ambuehl, Sebastian Blesse, Philipp Doerrenberg, Christoph Feldhaus, Axel Ockenfels
abstract: Much economic analysis derives policy recommendations based on social welfare criteria intended to model policymakers’ preferences. Yet, little is known about policymakers’ normative views suitable for this use. Our behavioural experiment elicits German legislators’ welfare criteria. When resolving preference conflicts across individuals, they place substantially more importance on least-favoured alternatives than on most-favoured alternatives, contrasting with common aggregation mechanisms and the equal weighting inherent in utilitarianism. When resolving preference conflicts within individuals, politicians choose inconsistently with behavioural economists’ most common approach to welfare analysis with time-inconsistent preferences. In distribution, politicians largely support the same welfare criteria as the public.
abstract_zh: 许多经济分析基于社会福利标准推导政策建议，旨在模拟政策制定者的偏好。然而，关于适合此用途的政策制定者规范观点，我们知之甚少。我们的行为实验揭示了德国立法者的福利标准。在解决个体间的偏好冲突时，他们赋予最不利选项的重要性远高于最有利选项，这与常见的聚合机制及功利主义中固有的平等加权形成对比。在解决个体内部的偏好冲突时，政治家的选择与行为经济学家在时间不一致偏好福利分析中最常用的方法不一致。在分配问题上，政治家与公众所支持的福利标准基本一致。
